labels.description: Additional labels to set on the created server

networks.description: Existing Hetzner Cloud private network names (or numeric IDs) to attach

firewalls.description: Existing Hetzner Cloud firewall names (or numeric IDs) to attach

placement_group.description: Existing Hetzner Cloud placement group name (or numeric ID) to attach

ssh_keys.description: Existing Hetzner Cloud SSH key names (or numeric IDs) for break-glass access. Talos itself never uses SSH.

enable_public_ipv4.description: Assign a public IPv4 address to the server. Defaults to true

enable_public_ipv6.description: Assign a public IPv6 address to the server. Defaults to true

extensions.description: Extra Talos system extensions to bake into the schematic

volumes.description: Additional Hetzner Cloud volumes to create and attach to the server

name.description: Volume name, suffixed with the request ID

format.description: Filesystem to format the volume with

automount.description: Automatically mount the volume on the server
